CLIENT PROJECT / 2026

Burp!

A fizzy little world. A whole lot of personality.

Brand identity · Packaging
THE STORY

A world of
its own.

The idea

BURP! is a low-sugar carbonated beverage brand made to sip, mix and share. The challenge was to make it feel thoughtful and premium without losing the fun.

The design

Expressive flavour characters, bold colour and a flexible packaging system give each drink its own personality. Together, they create a brand that feels confident, social and easy to enjoy.

Created during an internship with Casa De Villota Private Limited.
